messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled router shift: blue->green for service `inference-api` at 2026-03-21T15:15:00Z (in ~10m). Plan: incremental weights 2% / 10% / 30% / 100% over 2m / 6m / 6m / 10m. Rollback triggers: error-rate > 1.5% OR p99 latency > 450ms OR manual SRE abort. Runbook: https://rwd/ops/runbooks/router-shift. Operator: @elaine. Release notes: v2 — kernel-fix, KV-cache warmup, quant profile B.

elaine: heads-up — GPU warmers still catching up (60/150 warmed). prefer initial 2% not 5. also can we pin sensitive routes to v1 during ramp? :thinking:

ryan: +1 for 2%. We should pin `/v1/finetune` and `/v1/admin` to v1 for the next 30m. I updated route policy draft: `route_match: /v1/(finetune|admin) -> inference-api:v1`.

kai: propose metrics gating: hold at each step for full 2 minutes and require error-rate <= 0.5% and p95 <= 300ms to advance. If p95 spikes but error-rate low, we can still pause and investigate logs.

sre-oncall: noted. I'll watch the synthetic canary and infra metrics. alert if replica CPU > 85% or queue depth grows. Channel to watch: #eng-runtime.

maria: I've uploaded the preflight logs and the perf test output: https://rwd/ci/artefacts/1761239/inference-v2-load. small spike in tail latency under long context but overall ok.

elaine: tweak the router rule to 2% sample by header `x-exp` for initial traffic, sounds safer. something like:
```
- match: path: /v1/generate
  weight: 2
  header_sample: x-exp=v2
  backend: inference-api:v2
```

deploy-bot: Preflight checks OK (certs, healthchecks, config diff). Ready to start in 5m unless @elaine or @sre-oncall abort.

elaine: start when ready. I'll keep pins for `/v1/finetune` and `/v1/admin` in place for 30m. starting warmup of extra 20 GPUs now.

deploy-bot: Shift started at 1761239980. Applied 2% -> v2. Traffic snapshot: 2% (v2) / 98% (v1). Monitoring windows: 2m.

sre-oncall: canary synthetic p95 is 280ms; infra CPU stable. continuing.

2m check — ryan: metrics look green. advancing to 10% in 10s.

deploy-bot: weight update: 10% -> v2 at 1761240000.

sre-oncall: p95 jumped to 520ms on one region (eu-west). error-rate for that region still 0.6% but p99 creeping. pausing rollout and throttling to 5% globally.

elaine: pausing confirmed. roll instruction: set weight back to 5% and hold. can we pin the problematic cohort to v1 (eu-west) while we triage?

kai: doing quick diff — looks like kernel schedule causing KV cache churn on longer sequences. log snippet:
```
WARN kv_cache: miss_rate=0.38 seq_len=1024
```

maria: I'm rolling a config with extended KV warm TTL to the warmers in eu-west (flip in 30s). If that helps, we can resume.

deploy-bot: weight update: 5% -> v2 applied at 1761240012. Holding.

sre-oncall: after warm TTL patch p95 back down to 260ms and error-rate 0.4% in eu-west. recommend continue ramp slowly.

elaine: decision: continue with a slower cadence. new plan: 5% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with 10m hold at each step. proceed if no >1% errors and p99 < 450ms.

ryan: noted and updated release notes: pinned routes preserved. tagging release-shift: `inference-api:v2@1761239`.

deploy-bot: Resuming per new cadence. Next update scheduled in 10m. I'll post status updates and final confirmation when at 100%.

maria: thanks team. if anything looks off, ping me and I'll snapshot logs and open a regression eval. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: final note — document this pause and the TTL tweak in the post-release notes so we have a clear rollback rationale.

elaine: agreed. closing the thread once at 100% and no incidents.
